The term '''helm officer''' or '''helmsman''' was used to refer to the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of large vehicles such as [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], or of ground vehicles of a considerable size. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Bachenkall]] served as a helmsman aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].
